title: チームステータスランクアップ！

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer! You've been really giving it your all, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The academy has decided to reward you and your team for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We've upgraded your training facilities so you can train more efficiently!
